📚 Hard vocab word #13: ADULATION

adulation (noun): excessive praise or admiration.

✅ In a sentence: The young pianist handled the adulation of her fans with surprising calm.
✅ Similar: worship, idolization, flattery
✅ Remember it: Stronger than praise: think "fan worship."
